feeds.title: EXO Tower Blog
feeds.description: Learn more about tower gardening, Exotower, gardening tips and more! Born from a love of plants and a passion for people, the exotower was created to share the benefits of growing your own food from home, no matter what color your thumbs are. Exotower's home hydroponics system reuses water to prevent run off to the environment - saving the Earth and your bank account.
